comments.body:
## Validation

Implementation and complete-candidate checks are in progress. The current published commit records the approved ticket specification only; no validation result yet certifies a complete committed implementation.

The acceptance-first sequence found missing management facts and deletion behavior, then made focused tests pass. Independent review exposed a WorkOS SDK normalization edge case, now covered by failing real-wire acceptance cases. The complete validation will be rerun after that correction. Final base/head-bound results and any gate limitations will replace this progress record.

comments.body:
## Quality review

The candidate is in progress. Expected review tier: T2 Need architect because the shared OrganizationDirectory declaration changes. Independent human architect approval of the final candidate is required before merge; agent review is not that approval.

Independent agent review found that pinned WorkOS 11 converts a missing/null management field to false. The correction must preserve unknown wire evidence before that serializer. All other reviewed deletion paths keep exact-ID writes, proven no-effect refusals, and uncertain errors distinct. Final impact, declaration diffs, metrics, architecture assessment, and manager review will replace this progress record.
